loso.branch_a_mask: the frozen branch A is a 20-class closed set, so for a leave-identity-out fold its logit for the held identity is masked to -1e9 before the softmax; otherwise 'agree' would be 0 for every pseudo-unknown by construction and the calibration would be meaningless. This is the only way the Train agreement statistic has the same form as at Test (both branches choosing among the registered identities).
